projects.title: TarotParrot
projects.summary: Tarot shuffled by you. Your touch, your device’s motion and the moment you ask shape every deck, and each reading opens with a direct answer to your question, told through original watercolor-and-gold cards.

details.Spreads: Ten, from Single Pull to Celtic Cross

projects.image_alt: TarotParrot cover: the parrot perched on a glowing crystal ball above the title and A little birdie told me., over the app’s moving watercolor sky
